name: Nickolas Lewis
office: City of West Covina, City Clerk

items.text: Nickolas Lewis is the elected City Clerk of West Covina, a term that runs through November 2026. He was elected to the office in 2013. He also serves as chair of the West Covina Planning Commission.

sentences.text: Nickolas Lewis is the elected City Clerk of West Covina, a term that runs through November 2026.
He was elected to the office in 2013.
He also serves as chair of the West Covina Planning Commission.

items.text: During his 2013 campaign, he promised to work to make the city clerk an appointed position, arguing that salaried staff already performed the duties. In 2013, he was appointed to the board overseeing the wind-down of the city’s redevelopment agency.
